publication.paper_note: Section 4.2: original catalog hit search and subsequent visual lookalike selection; figures 7/9 explicitly lack quantitative axes. Original hit identity requires catalog event and family membership or author-supplied mapping, not just a raw hit at similar frequency.

candidate_audit.reference_epoch: scan-start diagnostic only; published figure frequency convention not established
candidate_audit.rule: No promotion from rounded frequencies even if consistent. Report residual and endpoint quantization; no post hoc threshold.

catalog_scout.scope: metadata only, exact file identities; no auto-download arbitrary URLs or claim that raw files identify author-selected events. Official index/directory only.

figure6.scope: Separate date but potentially related BLC1 family; not independent family. Verify native raw exact filename/header and panel sequence, do not resolve discrepancy by assumption.
figure6.rule: No spectral access in metadata scout, no label admission. If exact file and matching panel headers available, preregister separate replay of published frequency-range and off-source cadence.

r34_scout.scope: Metadata alias lookup only; no exam spectrum.
